*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Israel's role in the Syrian civil war]]
***Two [[Syrian Army|soldiers]] are killed during a series of [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]]s at [[Damascus International Airport]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/1/2/israeli-raid-shuts-down-damascus-airport-says-syria-military (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Kashmir conflict]]
**[[2023 Rajouri attacks]]
***Four [[civilian]]s are killed and six others injured when two gunmen [[mass shooting|open fire]] against [[Hindus|Hindu]] people's homes in [[Rajouri district]], [[Jammu and Kashmir (union territory)|Jammu and Kashmir]]. *[[Mexican drug war]]
**[[2023 Ciudad Juárez prison attack]]
***Ten [[prison officer]]s and four [[inmate]]s are killed in an armed attack on a prison in [[Ciudad Juárez]], [[Chihuahua (state)|Chihuahua]], [[Mexico]], in which 24 [[Prison escape|prisoners escaped]]. [https://www.deccanherald.com/international/world-news-politics/armed-attack-on-mexican-jail-leaves-14-dead-1177101.html (AFP via ''Deccan Herald'')]

**Two [[Palestinians]] are killed and three more injured during confrontations with [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] who stormed [[Kafr Dan]] to demolish the homes of two Palestinians killed in a [[shootout]] at a checkpoint in [[Jenin]] several months ago. '''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2023 inflation surge]]
**[[Canadian property bubble]]
***[[Canada]] enacts a [[Canadian property law|law]] prohibiting foreigners, except for [[Immigration to Canada|immigrants]] and [[Permanent residency in Canada|permanent residents]], from acquiring [[residential area]]s in the country for two years in response to a [[real-estate bubble]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/01/01/business/canada-bans-home-purchases-foreigners/index.html (CNN Business)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*At least nine people are killed and many others are injured during a [[Crowd collapses and crushes|stampede]] at a [[concert]] in [[Kampala]], [[Uganda]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/1/1/stampede-during-new-year-fireworks-kills-at-least-nine-in-uganda (Al Jazeera)]

*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]

***[[Australia]] and [[Canada]] announce that they will require travelers from [[China]] to present a negative [[COVID-19 test]] in order to enter their countries beginning on January 5. **The British arm of [[climate movement|climate protest]] group [[Extinction Rebellion]] announces it will "temporarily" shift away from using public disruption as a primary tactic. [https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/extinction-rebellion-uk-halt-disruptive-protests-2023-01-01/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Three [[New York City Police Department|police officers]] are wounded in a machete attack during [[New Year's Eve]] celebrations in [[Times Square]], [[New York City]], [[United States]]. The suspect, a 19-year-old male from [[Maine]], is also wounded and has been arrested, with [[Jihadism|jihadist]] motives being suspected. '''Politics and elections'''
*[[Enlargement of the eurozone]]
**[[Croatia and the euro]]
***Croatia [[Croatia and the euro|changes its national currency]] from the [[Croatian kuna|kuna]] to the [[euro]] to become 20th member state of the [[Eurozone]], and joins the European passport-free zone, the [[Schengen Area]]. [https://www.macaubusiness.com/croatia-switches-to-euro-enters-borderless-europe-club/ (AFP via ''Macau Business'')]
*[[Third inauguration of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]]
**[[Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva]] is sworn in as [[President of Brazil]] for the third time in his political career. [https://www.telam.com.ar/notas/202301/615958-asuncion-lula-da-silva-brasil.html (Télam)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[2023 Philippine airspace closure]]
**The [[Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines]] closes [[Philippines|the country]]'s [[airspace]] for nearly six hours due to a [[power outage]] in its [[air traffic management]] center, affecting more than 280 [[Commercial aviation|commercial flights]] and more than 56,000 passengers.
